title: Traditional British Rice Bowl
description: A simple and comforting dish originating from the UK, combining brown rice with a flavorful zesty sauce and crispy noodles.
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the package instructions.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the noodles to the skillet and stir-fry until lightly toasted.
Add the zesty sauce to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Combine the cooked brown rice and noodle mixture in a large bowl.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
Optional: add any desired protein such as tofu or tempeh to the noodle mixture.
